name: Thucydides the Historian
bio: Paton prints under the name of Thucydides the historian an epitaph ascribed to him. Paton's Index of Authors includes the poet among those of Book VII. Paton's index of authors gives no date for the poet.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 45).

poems.title: Book VII, 45: On the Same
poems.author: Thucydides the Historian
poems.text: All Hellas is the monument of Euripides, but the Macedonian land holds his bones, for it sheltered the end of his life. His country was Athens, the Hellas of Hellas, and as by his verse he gave exceeding delight, so from many he receiveth praise.
